entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [ci-scan] Test failure: SocketsHttpHandler_HttpClientHandler_ServerCertificates_Test bad-certificate cases on Android CoreCLR #135988
  • API Proposal: NativeArena for Scoped Native Memory Allocation #135986

    12.0.0

    12.0.0

  • Regex source generator ignores `cultureName` when deduplicating `[GeneratedRegex]` declarations and when it falls back to `new Regex(...)` #135977
  • Support distributed trace-context propagation across parent/child process invocations #135971
  • A zero-length ReadAsync on the serial base stream never completes on Windows. #135969
  • [wasm/R2R] TypeIntrinsics_r: GC reports uninitialized frame slots during throw-helper calls (pMT->Validate assert) #135966
  • Allow TypeMap trim targets to depend on the exact array type #135964
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `runtime/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #135960
  • [NativeAOT] Method body folding takes quadratic time with many async methods (struct state machines) #135942
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `runtime/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #135930
  • [API Proposal]: SP 800-56C one-step KDF over a caller-supplied shared secret #135926
  • JIT (x64, .NET 10): Vector128.CreateScalar(x).As<double, ulong>().ToScalar() returns garbage (backport of #129644?) #135923
  • [NativeAOT][RuntimeAsync] NullReferenceException awaiting Task<ValueTask> / Task<ValueTask<T>> #135922
  • ICorDebugILCode::GetEHClauses returns no clauses for a ReJIT IL body with a small-format EH section #135919
  • [wasm] Thread abort is raised inside finally and catch handlers of R2R code, so ControlledExecution.Run lets ThreadAbortException escape #135914
  • ILLink strips interfaces of an uninstantiated generic base class while the derived class keeps them, causing TypeLoadException #135913
    10.0.x
  • NativeAOT linux-x64: GC return-address hijack corrupts the caller's frame when a thread is suspended in the epilogue of a self-recursive fast tail call #135912
  • Complex.Tan returns infinities for a finite tangent near π/2 #135910
    12.0.0

Closed
